item.description:
Notes No. 9
19 October 1987: −22.6%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 22.6% in one session, its largest one-day percentage decline. Black Monday. 508 points in one day.
On Monday 19 October 1987 the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 508 points, from 2,246.74 to 1,738.74, a decline of 22.6% in one session. It remains the largest one-day percentage fall in the history of the index. Stock markets around the world fell sharply in the same days. A single session erased more than a fifth of the index value, far outside the range of ordinary daily moves. Source: Federal Reserve History; Dow Jones Industrial Average closing values, 1987.
